EPISODE_NARRATIVE: A trough moved from the eastern Great Lakes into the mid Atlantic then New England on Tuesday. Southern New England was in the warm sector of a weak low which provided enough instability for scattered thunderstorms Tuesday morning into early afternoon before the cold front moved through. There was an EF-1 tornado in Mattapoisett and an EF-0 tornado in Barnstable.
EVENT_NARRATIVE: In New Bedford, there were several reports of vehicles stuck in flooding on Orchard St and River St with flooding also on Dartmouth St at Hickory St.
